purpose: Multi-turn response trajectories recovered from the Laconic/Iconic lineage plus bounded new care/celebration scenes. Scene provenance and line provenance remain separate.

provenance_classes.EXACT: Scene wording recovered verbatim from an archived assistant response.
provenance_classes.RECONSTRUCTED: Scene mechanism recovered from prior work, but public-safe wording is newly reconstructed.
provenance_classes.RESEARCH_INFORMED: New scene whose response mechanics are informed by cited relationship/emotion research; not a clinical protocol.

lanes.law: Invite reciprocal play without trapping the other person in a bit.
Offer contact and choice before interpretation or advice.
Meet good news with enthusiasm and elaboration, not a flat acknowledgement.
Make re-entry easy; acknowledge residue without forcing a postmortem.

scenes.title: HOW ARE YOU?
scenes.note: Recovered 2–3-turn branching pattern. Preserved as donor, not silently promoted to current canon.

nodes.speaker: YOU
nodes.text: Depends. Do you want the polite answer or the honest one?
variants: That’s a dangerous question. Are you sure you’re ready for the truth?

nodes.speaker: YOU
nodes.text: Oh, you know, thriving in chaos.
variants: Breathing. That counts as winning, right?

nodes.speaker: YOU
nodes.text: Honestly? Somewhere between a meme and a meltdown.
variants: Let’s just say caffeine is doing the heavy lifting today.

nodes.speaker: YOU
nodes.text: Misery loves company, but let’s turn it into comedy instead.
variants: Glad to know I’m not the only one in this boat. Let’s paddle, shall we?

nodes.speaker: YOU
nodes.text: At this point, I’m basically 60% coffee, 40% hope.
variants: Honestly, coffee deserves more credit for holding society together.

nodes.speaker: YOU
nodes.text: True, but at least I’m learning how to surf the chaos.
variants: Life’s just a sitcom, and today I’m the comic relief.

scenes.title: WHAT DO YOU DO?
scenes.note: Recovered branch structure: opener creates three semantic frames, later reply follows the other person’s reaction.

nodes.speaker: YOU
nodes.text: Depends—do you mean officially, unofficially, or existentially?

nodes.speaker: YOU
nodes.text: I’m a professional chaos organizer.
variants: I solve problems people didn’t know they had.

nodes.speaker: YOU
nodes.text: I make memes out of life’s disasters.
variants: Mostly, I wander through hobbies and collect stories.

nodes.speaker: YOU
nodes.text: I’m a wanderer, searching for meaning while avoiding email.
variants: Mostly, I just try to matter to the people who matter.

nodes.speaker: YOU
nodes.text: Cool, yes. Stressful? Definitely. But isn’t everything worth doing?
variants: It’s like juggling fire. Fun, dangerous, and occasionally spectacular.

nodes.speaker: YOU
nodes.text: Glad I’m not the only one figuring it out as I go.
variants: It’s a vibe, isn’t it? Life’s just improv with deadlines.

nodes.speaker: YOU
nodes.text: It’s vague because the world’s too big for one answer.
variants: True, but the vague ones are usually the most fun.

scenes.title: WHY DID YOU DO THAT?
scenes.note: Recovered branching humor. Useful as a donor for structure even where individual lines later feel too performed.

nodes.speaker: YOU
nodes.text: Would you prefer the logical reason or the dramatic one?
variants: Depends—are you asking as a friend or a detective?

nodes.speaker: YOU
nodes.text: I calculated the risks, and this seemed the least disastrous.
variants: Because 2+2 equals 4, and this was 3.99.

nodes.speaker: YOU
nodes.text: Because chaos whispered my name, and I answered.
variants: Every great story starts with a reckless choice.

nodes.speaker: YOU
nodes.text: Logically, it made sense. Dramatically, it just felt right.
variants: It was either this or something boring, and I don’t do boring.

nodes.speaker: YOU
nodes.text: See? Even chaos gets it right sometimes.
variants: Glad you approve—makes it less reckless in hindsight.

nodes.speaker: YOU
nodes.text: Interesting? That’s just polite for genius.
variants: Life’s more fun when the reasons don’t fully make sense.

nodes.speaker: YOU
nodes.text: Ridiculous is my love language.
variants: The best ideas usually are.

scenes.title: CARE / CHOOSE THE KIND

source.title: Prison Age Meta-Game / private support-tree donor

scenes.note: Mechanism recovered from a private-context support tree: leave multiple low-pressure routes open. Sensitive historical specifics are intentionally not reproduced. All public wording below is NEW.

nodes.speaker: YOU
nodes.text: That sounds like a lot. Want company, thinking, practical help, or distraction?
variants: I’m here. Which mode helps: listen, think, do, or distract?

nodes.speaker: YOU
nodes.text: I’m here. You don’t have to make it tidy for me.
variants: Go at your speed. I can just hold the thread.

nodes.speaker: YOU
nodes.text: I hear you. I’m not going to rush you toward a conclusion.

nodes.speaker: YOU
nodes.text: What part feels hardest to name clearly?
variants: What’s the knot, not the whole rope?

nodes.speaker: YOU
nodes.text: So the live part is that—not everything around it. We can stay there.

nodes.speaker: YOU
nodes.text: Then we don’t need a label yet. What happened is enough to start from.

nodes.speaker: YOU
nodes.text: Give me one concrete thing I can take off the board.
variants: Pick one small burden. I can help carry that one.

nodes.speaker: YOU
nodes.text: Serious mode off for five minutes?
variants: I can supply nonsense until further notice.

nodes.speaker: YOU
nodes.text: Excellent. Reality has lost microphone privileges.
variants: Good. We’ll resume gravity when summoned.

nodes.speaker: YOU
nodes.text: No reply needed. Line stays open.
variants: You can leave this here. I’ll still be here later.

scenes.title: GOOD NEWS / CAPITALIZE
scenes.note: New scene. Uses enthusiasm + elaboration as the default response to another person’s positive event; not a recovered historical script.

nodes.speaker: YOU
nodes.text: Wait—tell me the good part properly.
variants: Hold on. I want the full victory lap.

nodes.speaker: YOU
nodes.text: That’s excellent. What part are you happiest about?
variants: Okay, that’s real. Which bit feels best?

nodes.speaker: YOU
nodes.text: You’re allowed to enjoy it before optimizing it.
variants: No shrinking it yet. This one gets to be good.

nodes.speaker: YOU
nodes.text: Good. Keep it warm for a minute.
variants: Then we don’t need analysis. Just yes.

scenes.title: REPAIR / AFTER A GAP
scenes.note: New scene built from the existing repair-line family: acknowledge the discontinuity, lower the re-entry cost, then give the other person control over depth.

nodes.speaker: YOU
nodes.text: I dropped the thread. Picking it back up here.
variants: I went quiet, not away.

nodes.speaker: YOU
nodes.text: Good. What’s still live?

nodes.speaker: YOU
nodes.text: Fair. We can address the gap before the topic.
variants: I hear the residue. We don’t have to skip over it.

nodes.speaker: YOU
nodes.text: Excellent. Minimal archaeology, maximum continuation.
variants: Then we resume without a committee hearing.

scenes.title: MIXED NEWS / HOLD BOTH
scenes.note: Mechanism recovered from a sensitive current-thread case: major good news and major difficult news can coexist. Public wording is newly reconstructed; private people, diagnoses and family details are intentionally omitted.

nodes.speaker: YOU
nodes.text: That’s a lot of life arriving at once. Want me to hold the good, the hard, or both?
variants: Two big truths at once. Which one needs company first?

nodes.speaker: YOU
nodes.text: Then let the good news have its own oxygen. What part do you want to enjoy first?
variants: No shrinking it yet. The good part gets to be good.

nodes.speaker: YOU
nodes.text: Joy isn’t betrayal. It can sit beside fear without cancelling it.
variants: You don’t have to make the feelings agree.

nodes.speaker: YOU
nodes.text: Good. Keep that part warm for a minute.
variants: Then we don’t optimize it. We let it land.

nodes.speaker: YOU
nodes.text: Then we stay with the hard part. No fixing unless you ask.
variants: I can witness, think with you, or take one concrete thing off the board.

nodes.speaker: YOU
nodes.text: You don’t have to make it tidy for me.
variants: Go at your speed. I can just hold the thread.

nodes.speaker: YOU
nodes.text: Name one small burden I can actually carry.
variants: One concrete thing. I’ll tell you plainly if I can take it.

nodes.speaker: YOU
nodes.text: We don’t have to choose a dominant emotion. I can hold both with you.
variants: Joy and fear can share the room. Neither needs permission from the other.

nodes.speaker: YOU
nodes.text: No reply needed. Line stays open.
variants: You can leave this here. I’ll still be here later.

scenes.title: SCRIPT PRESSURE / NAME THE MOVE

source.title: Prison Age / Naming / Sleeper Script ancestral mechanism

scenes.note: Public-safe mechanism transfer: ambiguous pressure becomes an explicit observation, request, role-cast, or unresolved signal. This preserves the ancestral rectification-of-names / sleeper-script move without importing private source details or treating the metaphor as a factual hidden-control claim.

nodes.speaker: YOU
nodes.text: Quick naming check: is that an observation, a request, or a role you’re assigning me?
variants: Before I answer: fact, ask, or casting?

nodes.speaker: YOU
nodes.text: Good. Make it specific enough to test.
variants: Then let’s get it out of adjective-land and into evidence.

nodes.speaker: YOU
nodes.text: Now we have something real enough to disagree with.
variants: Excellent. A claim with edges.

nodes.speaker: YOU
nodes.text: Good. Ask me cleanly and I can actually answer.
variants: Requests are easier than atmospheres. What do you want?

nodes.speaker: YOU
nodes.text: That I can work with.
variants: There. Now we’re playing the same game.

nodes.speaker: YOU
nodes.text: Casting requires consent. What do you actually need from me?
variants: That role isn’t self-executing. Translate it into a request.

nodes.speaker: YOU
nodes.text: You can describe the role. You can’t assign it by atmosphere.
variants: Keep the description; release the casting.

nodes.speaker: YOU
nodes.text: Then we don’t have to obey it yet.
variants: Unnamed pressure is not an instruction.

nodes.speaker: YOU
nodes.text: Cool. Fog successfully demoted.
variants: Excellent. The Ministry has lost jurisdiction.
